headline: Zulte won the last meeting 4-0 — but arrive on 3 straight defeats
summary: Zulte Waregem won the last meeting with La Louvière 4-0 at home in April, and earlier that month they won 2-0 at the same ground. They return there on Saturday as favourites — but only just. Zulte have lost their last 3 league games and sit 8th with 11 points, while RAAL are 16th with 4. The home side concede 2.24 expected goals a game, which is the visitors' clearest route to a result. The market average, margin removed, gives Zulte 40.8% to win, against 31.1% for La Louvière and 28.1% for the draw. The handicap rates them only 0.19 goals better.
read: Zulte Waregem are the away favourites at 40.8%, but the market's own handicap line rates them only about 0.19 goals better than a RAAL side sitting 16th with a -10 goal difference. The visitors have lost their last three league games and average under one expected goal per game, while RAAL's defence concedes 2.24 xG a game — an even, low-margin game is the picture, with the 2.5-goal line split right down the middle at 50.3%.

facts.fact: Zulte Waregem are the favourites at 40.8% to win at La Louvière, against 31.1% for the home side and 28.1% for the draw.
facts.meaning: The market makes the away team the more likely winner, but only by about ten points over RAAL — not a one-sided game.

facts.fact: Zulte Waregem won 2-0 at La Louvière last April, four days after beating them 4-0 at home, and are unbeaten in the last five meetings.
facts.meaning: The visitors have recent, direct proof they can win at this ground, which backs up their favourite tag.

facts.fact: RAAL La Louvière's league goal difference is -10 after eight games — one win, one draw and six defeats.
facts.meaning: That is the record of a side fighting at the bottom, and it is the main reason they start as home underdogs.

facts.fact: Zulte Waregem have lost their last three league games — 0-2 at home to Gent, 0-3 at Anderlecht and 0-1 at home to Charleroi.
RAAL have conceded an average of 2.24 expected goals across their last four league games, including 4.88 in the 1-4 home defeat to Club Brugge.
facts.meaning: The home defence gives up good chances at a high rate, which is the clearest route to a Zulte win.

facts.fact: Zulte Waregem average 0.98 expected goals per game over their last five, under one chance-quality goal a match.
facts.meaning: The favourites are not a free-scoring side, so an away win likely comes by a single goal rather than a big scoreline.

facts.fact: Over 2.5 goals is priced at 50.3%, with the market's 50/50 goal line at 2.51 — dead level on the main line.
facts.meaning: The market sees an even split between a two-goal and a three-goal-plus game, so the total is genuinely open.

facts.fact: On the handicap the market rates Zulte only about 0.19 goals better, and RAAL +0.25 is a 52.3% shot.
facts.meaning: The away favouritism is paper-thin: the market's picture is a draw or a one-goal game either way.

sources.fact: RAAL La Louvière beat RFC Liège 4-0 in the Belgian Cup to reach the round of 16.
La DH reports that RAAL want to avoid a repeat of their post-Kortrijk slump when they face Zulte Waregem in the league.
RAAL La Louvière announced the return of fitness coach Pablo Morchon to their staff.
Massimiliano Ledda will referee the match, with Bert Put on VAR.
FootNews reports that Zulte Waregem started the season very well but have dropped off somewhat.
Zulte Waregem have signed 19-year-old striker Joaquin Obambi, who scored four goals and provided three assists in eight matches for Jong Essevee and will join the first team.
Dylan Deves has extended his contract with Zulte Waregem.
